summary: Pair with a computer to mirror a terminal session on e-ink.
release_notes: Pairing and terminal screens are now checked against each supported reader's own type, including the Kobo Nia, at every text size.

steps.text: Run kobo stream init on the computer, install its stream trust root on the Kobo, then start kobo stream.

page_description: Mirror a terminal session from your computer onto e-ink. The shell, credentials, and scrollback stay on the computer; the Kobo renders the session over a paired connection.
